## [1.1.1](https://github.com/RAZORRZR0/gtasa-de-morphe-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1) (2026-11-02)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* ModMenu tabs only for mods with settings, tapping a listed mod no longer opens the Options page; Loading Music config is LoadingMusic.ini ([7c8d109](https://github.com/RAZORRZR0/gtasa-de-morphe-patches/commit/7c8d109e865949df876f70589374642679cbc4da))
* Pak Loader description explains how pak mods load ([682d6bb](https://github.com/RAZORRZR0/gtasa-de-morphe-patches/commit/682d6bb9f0c1a60110e4281fc90dc2c6636d7b99))

patches.name: CLEO
patches.description: CLEO Android 2.0.1: runs CLEO scripts with the swipe-down CLEO menu, script text and touch. Installs its 14 GTA SA scripts in Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa.de/cleo/ (the .csa ones, such as invincibility and regeneration, always run: delete the ones you don't want).

patches.name: GTA Prop Fix
patches.description: Restores map props missing from the Definitive Edition.

patches.name: Loading Music
patches.description: Plays one of the game's eight loading-screen themes (S_000-S_007) while a save loads, like the PC SALoadingMusic mod.

patches.name: ModMenu
patches.description: In-game settings menu for the other mods.

patches.name: Pak Loader
patches.description: Loads Unreal .pak mod files from Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa.de/paks/ when the game starts. They load above the game's own paks, so any file a mod pak contains replaces the game's copy (PC Definitive Edition pak mods work as-is). Copy the .pak files there and restart the game. Ships no game files.

patches.name: Project Props
patches.description: Project Props 4: about 16,000 extra map props. Downloads the Project Props placements from github.com/user-grinch/Project-Props while patching (needs internet).

patches.name: SkyGfx
patches.description: PS2-style graphics: PS2 timecyc, radiosity, distant lamp coronas, post effects.
